summary: 10.0.34 Enterprise Release - Master Lookup Authority, Credit/Debit Note Autocomplete & Date/Time Normalization
highlights: 1. Flyway migration V10_0_34_1: Seeded Master Categories for Business Type, Industry, Currency, Timezone, Date & Time Formats, and Credit/Debit Note reasons into database lookup_master
2. Desktop & Web Settings: Replaced hardcoded dropdown lists with live Master Lookup queries with seamless fallback defaults and value preservation
3. Credit Note & Debit Note: Searchable Customer & Supplier autocomplete via PartySearchUi, cascading invoice/bill selection with auto-fill taxable totals, and Master Lookup GST rate & reasons
4. Date & Time / Timestamp: System-wide date/time normalization across headers, footers, status clocks, and PDF rendering using company.dateFormat and company.timeFormat
5. Quotations: Async background PDF/Excel generator and direct Save-PDF-To dialog with error isolation
